While Superhoe may not be a perfect piece of theatre, Nicôle Lecky shows great promise both as a writer and actor and might even have an alternative career on the cards as a rapper.

cn.t: Lecky's bold one-woman show earns praise for its fresh voice and thrilling performance, frankly exploring modern struggles with social media, financial pressures, and identity through an engaging mix of monologue and rap.
